TOOLING BURST T3a-1 — SPEC § 7 row "T3a-1 — video cut, loops" (Run C-3, the matrix run: motion tooling for cutting Grok image-to-video clips into registered game loops). task_id "T3a-1".

Read ONLY, in this order:
1. /Users/admin/Games/reincarnated-collaboration/astra_test_01/burst/SPEC.md — § 0, § 1, and § 7 (the intro paragraph and the row "T3a-1 — video cut, loops" — that row is your contract; its Acceptance column is how your work is measured).
2. /Users/admin/Games/reincarnated-collaboration/astra_test_01/burst/BURST_RULES.md (the TOOLING row).
3. gates/matte.py (extract), gates/g6_seam.py, oracle/motion_map.py, oracle/walk_landmarks.py (docstrings + figure_mask/landmarks for our RGBA frames), oracle/idle_curves.py (period helpers — reuse, do not duplicate), runs/C-1/artifacts/K3p-xv-cut-04/registration.json and runs/C-1/artifacts/K3p-xv-idle-cut-01/registration.json (the C-2 cuts you must reproduce), tests/test_oracle_idle.py (synthetic helpers). The real clips are runs/C-1/xvideo/in/walk_E_grok.mp4 and runs/C-1/xvideo/in/idle_C_grok.mp4 (768×1168, 24 fps, 145 frames, #00ff00 plate) — read-only.
Do not read anything else. No web. No agents. No image generation. No pip install. stdlib + Pillow + numpy + scipy (+ sklearn) ONLY; ffmpeg/ffprobe at /opt/homebrew/bin/.

BUILD exactly the SPEC row — every function named, with the named parameters and defaults, and its tests (unittest, stdlib) including the known-bad cases. Write tests/test_video_cut.py (synthetic cases only — fast, < 20 s) and tests/acceptance_t3a.py (the real-clip acceptance; writes runs/C-3/t3/T3a-1/acceptance.json + one strip PNG per clip; run it once and report its numbers; it is NOT added to run_t0c.py).
Then run the FULL suite: `cd /Users/admin/Games/reincarnated-collaboration/astra_test_01/burst && PYTHONDONTWRITEBYTECODE=1 python3 -B tests/run_t0c.py` — expected: all green except the named standing reds (the four T0-d3 motif reds: test_f04_outside_at_least_three + three test_named_genuine_annuli_retained subtests; test_synthetic_contract_and_grid; and test_k3_combat_report_only until T3c fixes it); report exact counts (tests_run, successful) and name every red.

DO NOT touch: lane/, bible/, fixtures/, briefs/, SPEC.md, BURST_RULES.md, REGISTER_CARD.md, JUDGE_RUBRIC.md, MANIFEST.sha256, receipt.schema.json, transcribe.schema.json, anything under runs/ except runs/C-3/t3/T3a-1/, and any existing test file except where the SPEC row names a fix. Existing modules may be EXTENDED only as the row says (new parameters with backward-compatible defaults; the regression lock must stay green). Do not run git. Temporary files ONLY under tests/tmp/ or runs/C-3/t3/T3a-1/tmp/ (delete large temporaries — decoded video frames — before you return).
PRIORITY if time runs short: the instruments and their synthetic tests first, the real-clip acceptance second, polish never; deliver what is done with honest concerns rather than exceeding the cap.

RETURN: the receipt (task_id "T3a-1"): files = every file you created or modified (repo-absolute or burst-relative paths) with sha256; images []; calls_used 0; status DELIVERED / DELIVERED_WITH_CONCERNS / FAILED; concerns with numbers (every acceptance quantity: measured value vs the SPEC row's criterion; wall times; suite counts). Never PASS/FAIL.
